status: Structure only. The section sequence is the eight-section upsell derived in Skill 80 (profile signature-upsell-eight-section). Skill 80's validate_upsell_copy.py stays the authority on the copy itself; this file lets Skill 71's section-count check and request builder accept the page.
decline_label: No thanks - continue without this extra

sections.job: Name the extra offer and its added outcome at once; the order is confirmed above it; every section ends in a filled CTA with the exact amount and terms directly under it and a plain decline link.
First distinct remaining challenge the extra offer solves.
Why this extra offer exists and why it matters now.
Who benefits from the upgrade, without shaming anyone who declines.
The exact extra inclusions beside a price-and-terms panel; nothing already in the original purchase is shown as new.
Seven distinct numbered reasons to commit, then the final CTA and terms line.

cta_map.note: A CTA in every section, including Who and What (the main-page no-CTA rules do not apply to an upsell).

containment.no_extras_rule: A section id outside 1 to 8, a duplicate, or a lettered child id fails.
